Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 Rocket Completes Maiden Flight

Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 rocket successfully completed its maiden flight, reaching orbit. Following this achievement, the company announced plans to construct its own launch pad. The success is attributed by some reports to the Indian government's policies and institutional support for the private space sector.
